mating_design.name: CompassTag self-contained board
mating_design.source: Inferred from CompassTag schematic U302 plus user-provided low-power intent.
notes: This is a self-contained STM32L432-based tag, not a breakout with a separate mating MCU.
The board is designed for roughly 10 uA typical current, below 1 mA operating current, and about 10 mA peak current during flash write.
Several chip-select, clock, wake, reset, and power-enable nets depend on explicit STM32 reset/sleep GPIO configuration.
The AK09940A 1.8 V rail is controlled by STM32 PA9 through AK_PWR / TPS7A2018 EN.
AT25_nCS does not have an external pull-up; firmware/internal pull configuration must keep flash deselected during reset/sleep.

population_options.notes: Current design depends on STM32 PA15 internal pull-up/reset-state handling for AT25_nCS.

suppressions.reason: Low-power design: user-provided currents are about 10 uA typical, below 1 mA operating, and about 10 mA peak during flash write. Treat 0.1016 mm traces as advanced-process DFM notes, not current-capacity concerns.
+2V5 source is through the VBAT/D401 path and KiCad ERC is clean; keep as documented power-tree intent.
VBAT is the external/battery input rail; KiCad ERC is clean.
AT25_nCS deselect is a firmware/reset-state contract using STM32 PA15 internal pull-up unless an external pull-up is later added.
LIS2DU12 interrupt/wake pull behavior is handled by STM32 GPIO configuration; review WKUP1 state in firmware.
CompassTag uses J201 and small connector/test features for access; explicit ICT-style test-point coverage is not the production-test target for this prototype.
Connectors are tag contacts/debug/test features rather than user cable interfaces; treat EMC filtering suggestions as low-priority unless used with cables.
J201 is a compact SWD/debug header; ground-pin ratio warning is informational for this prototype.
Intentional two-layer compact low-power tag. Treat as return-path/EMC caution, not a stackup blocker.
